title: Frederick Chung
intro:
Report an officeholder change
Frederick S. Chung is a judge of the Superior Court of Santa Clara County in California. Chung assumed office in 2018.
Chung is running for election for judge of the California 6th District Court of Appeal. Chung is on the ballot in the retention election on November 3, 2026.
Chung won re-election for judge of the Superior Court of Santa Clara County in California outright without appearing on the ballot. If the elections had not been canceled, the primary would have been held on June 2, 2026, and the general election would have been held on November 3, 2026.
